description.en: Canonical multi-dimensional taxonomy for dislop's AI-Slop Pattern Library: organizes observable AI writing, rhythm, discourse, UI, and slide deck patterns by linguistic/visual layer and detection angle.
description.zh: dislop AI 味模式库的多维分类体系：按语言、节奏、语篇、界面与幻灯片层级以及检测角度组织可观测的 AI 味模式资产。

summary.en: Objective AI generation leftovers that never belong in shipped output: chatbot wrappers, unfilled brackets, raw Markdown in Office docs, and dead placeholder UI controls.
summary.zh: 明显不该留在成品里的客观生成残迹：AI 寒暄壳、未填占位符、贴进 Office 没渲染的裸 Markdown，以及点不动的占位控件。

name.zh: 词汇、高频词组与翻译腔

summary.en: Over-represented AI vocabulary, promotional buzzwords, bureaucratic abstractions, and Chinese translation-calque clusters.
summary.zh: 大模型超额偏好的英文词汇、公文抽象黑话，以及高密度出现的中文翻译腔与空洞连接词簇。

summary.en: Formulaic sentence shells that survive synonym swaps: 'Not X, but Y' pivots, 3-part balanced semicolon pitches, staccato slogan chains, four-character triads, and rhetorical self-Q&A.
summary.zh: 换掉高频词后依然残留的句式骨架：“不是 A，而是 B”反转、三段分号排比、超短断句口号、四字排比串与自问自答过渡句。

name.zh: 语言节奏、韵律与排版密度

summary.en: Distribution-level cadence artifacts caused by autoregressive smoothing: 5+ comma chains, low sentence-length variance (metronome effect), repetitive openers, em-dash saturation, and inline bold spam.
summary.zh: 由自回归平滑和助手排版习惯导致的节奏失真：连续逗号链、句长节拍器效应、连续同构开头、破折号过密与正文加粗泛滥。

summary.en: Paragraph- and document-level assistant habits: throat-clearing openers, mechanical transition clusters, bold-lead list walls, moralizing endings, and unsourced authority claims.
summary.zh: 段落与整篇层面的助手化习惯：铺垫开场白、机械过渡路标簇、加粗列表墙、段尾说教升华与无出处权威背书。

name.zh: 网页界面与幻灯片模板

summary.en: Static markup, CSS, and OOXML template tropes: purple-pink gradients, pill-badge soup, triple nested boxes, glassmorphism walls, thick left accent stripes, prompt-echo badges, and crowded or monotonous slides.
summary.zh: 前端源码与 PPTX XML 中的模板味：紫粉渐变、满屏胶囊标签、三层套盒、毛玻璃堆砌、侧边粗彩条、营销徽章与超载或单调幻灯片。

name.zh: 加权词库与短语簇密度
前端标记与 Office XML 结构探针
跨维度多信号复合共现
